explanation: This test only initiates a top-up and checks that the wallet balance increases, which partially covers the credit_before_debit requirement by verifying the wallet is credited. However, it does not verify that the FX rate is locked at initiation (fx_lock), that the funding source is debited only after crediting (credit_before_debit), that a timeout rolls back the transaction (timeout_rollback), or that dual approval is required for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval).
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at top-up initiation
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet is credited
Verify transaction rolls back if provider callback times out after 5 seconds
Verify top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second owner approval before settlement
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the FX rate is not locked at initiation, causing inconsistent exchange rates, would not be detected. Also, a bug where the funding source is debited before the wallet is credited, or where a timeout does not roll back the transaction, would be missed. Finally, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require dual approval would not be caught.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up transaction behavior including FX rate lock, credit before debit, timeout rollback, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Verify FX rate is locked at initiation
Verify wallet balance increases by SGD 500
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet is credited
Simulate provider callback timeout after 5 seconds and verify transaction is rolled back with no changes
Verify that second business owner approval is required before settlement
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; wallet balance increases by top-up amount; funding source is debited only after wallet is credited; transaction rolls back on provider callback timeout; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second owner approval before settlement
